segments.text: Countless businesses rely on Dynamics 365 Business Central every day to manage and optimize finance, operations, inventory, and beyond.
And now with the power of Microsoft and Agentic AI, the next evolution of business agility is here. Workflow automation with Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent.
Sales Order Agent takes the hassle out of order processing. No more manual entry or chasing down details. Orders come in, quotes go out,
inventory is checked, and your customers get what they need fast and accurately. Payables agent is your finance team's new best friend.
It reads vendor invoices, classifies invoice lines, assigns to the appropriate accounts, and routes them for approval.
So you can manage repeat tasks without having to focus on repeatable processes. And this is just the beginning. In addition to what we are building, you can start building your own agents today.

Automate your unique workflows. Connect to other Microsoft tools and customize agents to fit your business perfectly with the security, transparency, and configurability you already expect from Business Central.
Scale up. Do more. No compromises. Are you ready to build the future of business productivity?
